benefits.hypothesis: Better choice of doctor. Specialty guidance and preference matching can reduce wrong-destination appointments.
Less avoidable demand. Reviewed advice for suitable concerns may resolve questions without an unnecessary visit.
benefits.suggested_measure: Clinically adjudicated avoidable visits; delayed-care events

benefits.hypothesis: Less repetitive intake. Confirmed histories and concise summaries can reduce repeat questioning and preparation time.
benefits.suggested_measure: Net staff minutes per episode, including correction time

benefits.hypothesis: More useful appointment capacity. Redirecting unsuitable demand can free slots for patients needing those services.
benefits.suggested_measure: Wait time and filled capacity by specialty

benefits.hypothesis: Lower avoidable episode spending. Fewer inappropriate visits and better navigation may lower total episode cost.
benefits.suggested_measure: Risk-adjusted allowed cost per episode with quality controls

benefits.hypothesis: Less travel and confusion. Clear actions, visit options and a portable summary can reduce navigation effort.
benefits.suggested_measure: Time to next step; out-of-pocket cost; comprehension

benefits.hypothesis: Greater control of sensitive data. Local inference and lifecycle controls reduce dependence on external processing.
benefits.suggested_measure: Verified outbound payloads; deletion completion; access tests

benefits.hypothesis: Observable and adaptable AI delivery. Versioned local models, visible evidence and reproducible builds support technical oversight.
benefits.suggested_measure: Reproducible run rate; recovery time; measured cost per run

measurement_rule: Synthetic completion, export clicks, and model latency are not avoided visits, clinician time saved, or insurer savings.
